newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 slips again as Komercni falls further.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 slips again as Komercni falls further.

text.p: The Czech PX50 continued to edge lower at Tuesday's fixing, led once again by Komercni Banka which accounts for 11 percent of the index's capitalisation.

Komercni lost a further 15 crowns at the fixing to 1,575 after dropping 50 crowns in the previous session. Dealers blame Komercni's decline on investor worries about the knock-on effect of heavy flooding affecting a third of the country.
Meanwhile, the country's largest insurer Ceska Pojistovna rose 30 crowns to 2,500. Pojistovna has fallen in the wake of the flooding but has recently stabilised.
German insurer Munich Re. was reported in local Czech newspapers as estimating total insurance payouts because of the flooding at around 23 billion crowns.
Mlada Fronta Dnes also said Ceska Pojistovna estimated its payouts at five billion crowns, the majority of which should be covered by re-insurance.
